purpose.zh: 在全范围内主动控制髋关节
purpose.en: Move the hip through its full range under control.

text.zh: 膝盖抬起，画出髋能做到的最大圆
text.en: Lift your knee and draw the biggest circle your hip allows
Keep your pelvis and spine still.

text.zh: 向前、向外、向后，再反方向画回
text.en: Go forward, out, and back, then reverse the circle.

commonErrors.en: Rotating the pelvis with the leg.

cautions.zh: 髋不适时缩小圆圈，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Make the circle smaller if your hip feels uncomfortable, and stop if it still hurts.

cautions.zh: 先做手腕热身；手腕刺痛或发麻就停止
cautions.en: Warm up your wrists first, and stop if they feel sharp pain or numbness.
